about: Who acts: the person, the nine agent roles with exactly what each may write, the automation planes, and the test doubles. Authority is code: a person's acts are verbs that refuse an automated actor.
authority: src/orchestration/run/roles.ts (grantFor, CONTENT_ROLES, DENIED_BASE), src/shared/automation.ts (AGENT_ROLES, DEFAULTS), CLAUDE.md

person.name: A person (the approver)

acts.act: approve or reject a topic proposal
acts.how: reply APPROVE <slug> / REJECT <slug>: <why> / APPROVE ALL to the batch mail, or npm run topics -- approve|reject

acts.act: claim a topic for an institution and add a channel
acts.how: npm run topics -- claim; a new commission in src/config/site.ts by hand
topics/<topic>/production.json (queued, parked with a note): the one hand-written planning input
/produce <topic> <story-id> with an Approver: line, or npm run run -- story; the production pick does it when enabled.production

acts.act: accept the draft or send it back
acts.how: reply OK or CHANGES: to the draft mail, or the review page; by policy an agent may (review.draft: agent), never for a release
reply OK / OK at <when> / CHANGES: / PAID OK to the release mail (publish decide), or the review page, or npm run publish -- approve
publish decide --verdict schedule --at, or publish -- go-live | scheduled

acts.act: approve a paid call to action
acts.how: PAID OK (n) in the reply or npm run links -- cta approve; needs a disclosure; never primary over a tool
OK to the correction mail (article decide), or article -- correct --approved-by --note; reaffirm --note keeps a stale text
publish unpublished (Studio step recorded), a note in the description and publish -- push
automation.json enabled.* by hand, committed; create the scheduled tasks from schedule --print
publish -- updated --fields relatedVideo | endScreen | cards; uploaded --id when the API kept it private

person.gatesRule: gates names the edge (objects.json) a person's decision sits on, at the object it is written into; short is the label the admin System model draws.

agentRoles.brief: script.md, storyboard.md, article.md, cta.md, video (render.json, music.json)
agentRoles.validator: npm run script -- validate; article -- validate; links -- cta; video -- check
agentRoles.limit: three revisions per pass to clear blocking findings; needsEvidence stops and asks

agentRoles.rule: never the same agent as the writer; approvals are by sentence fingerprint
the only role that writes code; the tree guard typechecks its components before any child loads them; every bespoke graphic needs a visual review

agentRoles.validator: evidence -- check-batch | check-merges; typed batches in batches.ts

agentRoles.rule: the only two verbs a collect agent may run
shadow: recorded, no effect; agent: may accept-draft or send back a draft build, never a release; two rounds then the person
its reply becomes report -- note calls; it writes nothing

everyRoleDenied: anything outside its writable list: the tree guard reverts it (unexpected-edit)

agentFacts.command: claude -p, one call = one attempt record (models, tokens, cost, turns, api time, cap, overCap; never the prompt or reply)
agentFacts.models: an alias per role in automation.json agents.models (default opus); tests and fixture runs use sonnet or haiku
agentFacts.budget: perAgent cap asked of the CLI (it can overshoot), perRun, perTopic, perWeek checked before each agent; budget.json is the gate
agentFacts.validation: every brief has a deterministic validator; findings go back to the same session for runs.validationRounds rounds

tick.what: the control plane: preflight, outbox flush, inbox poll (decide, approve/reject, article decide), halt and digest mails, resume and stuck detection, the due step (schedules past time, Shorts in order, renewals), the launch probe and the X post; never runs a story

work.what: the work plane: one due long job then exit: a resume, the production pick, a topic run, a launch, a scan, the discovery job
work.flag: enabled.work plus the job's own flag (production, research, discovery, maintenance)

pick.what: starts a ready story with approver 'automated: production pick <date>, enabled by <approverName>'; skips partOf, parked, halted, unclaimed and fixture topics; cadence knobs: production.weekday, hour, storiesPerWeek, perInstitutionPerWeek, maxAwaitingApproval

storyRun.what: the loop over boardNext: each step a module CLI child with only its verb's secrets, or a budgeted agent followed by its validator; journals, halts with a kind and an unblock, validates and commits

releaseLoop.what: draft upload by policy, video final once accepted, the Shorts, every output uploaded private, pushed and verified, the release manifest, publish request --channel email; dispatches on publishing's OutputStep

topicRun.what: the research pipeline over topicNext: collect, extract, merge, record, studies, judge, record-sources, report, notes, stories, review; parks thin topics

discovery.what: weekly: one discover.md agent per institution, one proposal-review.md agent per proposal, topics -- batch, one mail

maintain.what: the scan (new-sources agent, record-sources, scanned, report, notes, stories, commit) then the article pass (reaffirm or correction request)

launch.what: after go-live and verify: report -- seed, brand, build, links freeze, validate, commit, push; the tick probes the deploy and posts on X

automation.defaults: every enabled.* flag is false; review.draft is person; nothing runs unattended until a person verifies and enables each integration

testDoubles: the fixture topic test-fixture: the real pipeline on a 15 s story, private uploads, preview deploy only; never a test mode
